collapse.description: whether the menu is collapsed (available only in vertical mode)
collapse.description_zh: 是否水平折叠收起菜单（仅在 mode 为 vertical 时可用）

ellipsis.description: whether the menu is ellipsis (available only in horizontal mode)
ellipsis.description_zh: 是否使用省略号（仅在 mode 为 horizontal 时可用）

ellipsis-icon.description: custom ellipsis icon (available only in horizontal mode and ellipsis is true)
ellipsis-icon.description_zh: 自定义省略号图标（仅在 mode 为 horizontal 且 ellipsis 为 true 时可用）

:popper-offset.description: offset of the popper (effective for all submenus)
:popper-offset.description_zh: 弹出菜单的偏移量（对所有子菜单有效）

background-color.description: background color of Menu (hex format) (use `--el-menu-bg-color` in a style class instead)
background-color.description_zh: 菜单的背景色（请使用 `--el-menu-bg-color` 在样式类中代替）

text-color.description: text color of Menu (hex format) ( use `--el-menu-text-color` in a style class instead)
text-color.description_zh: 菜单的文字颜色（请使用 `--el-menu-text-color` 在样式类中代替）

active-text-color.description: text color of currently active menu item (hex format) ( use `--el-menu-active-color` in a style class instead)
active-text-color.description_zh: 当前激活菜单的文字颜色（请使用 `--el-menu-active-color` 在样式类中代替）

default-active.description: index of active menu on page load
default-active.description_zh: 页面加载时当前激活菜单的 index

:default-openeds.description: array that contains indexes of currently active sub-menus
:default-openeds.description_zh: 当前打开的 sub-menu 的 index 的数组

unique-opened.description: whether only one sub-menu can be active
unique-opened.description_zh: 是否只保持一个子菜单的展开

menu-trigger.description: how sub-menus are triggered, only works when `mode` is 'horizontal'
menu-trigger.description_zh: 子菜单打开的触发方式(只在 mode 为 horizontal 时有效)

router.description: whether `vue-router` mode is activated. If true, index will be used as 'path' to activate the route action. Use with `default-active` to set the active item on load.
router.description_zh: 是否使用 vue-router 的模式，启用该模式会在激活导航时以 index 作为 path 进行路由跳转

collapse-transition.description: whether to enable the collapse transition

popper-effect.description: Tooltip theme, built-in theme: `dark` / `light` when menu is collapsed
popper-effect.description_zh: Tooltip 主题，内置主题：`dark` / `light`，在菜单折叠时有效

close-on-click-outside.description: optional, whether menu is collapsed when clicking outside
close-on-click-outside.description_zh: 可选，是否在点击菜单外部时收起菜单

popper-class.description: custom class name for all popup menus
popper-class.description_zh: 为所有弹出菜单添加自定义类名

:show-timeout.description: control timeout for all menus before showing
:show-timeout.description_zh: 控制所有菜单显示前的超时时间

:hide-timeout.description: control timeout for all menus before hiding
:hide-timeout.description_zh: 控制所有菜单隐藏前的超时时间

persistent.description: when menu inactive and `persistent` is `false` , dropdown menu will be destroyed
persistent.description_zh: 当菜单未激活且 `persistent` 为 `false` 时，下拉菜单将会被销毁

events.name: select
events.description: callback function when menu is activated

exposed.name: open
exposed.description: open a specific sub-menu, the param is index of the sub-menu to open

exposed.name: close
exposed.description: close a specific sub-menu, the param is index of the sub-menu to close

typeDetail.MenuSelectEvent: (index: string, indexPath: string[], item: MenuItemClicked, routerResult?: Promise<void | NavigationFailure>) => void
typeDetail.MenuItemRegistered: { index: string, indexPath: string[], active: boolean }
typeDetail.MenuItemClicked: { index: string, indexPath: string[], route?: RouteLocationRaw }
